# ezghcloud_api_key (Resource)

Manage an EZGH Cloud api_key.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name value.

### Optional

- `bot_id` (String) The botId value.
- `expires_in_seconds` (Number) Requested lifetime in seconds (900 to 31536000).

### Read-Only

- `expires_at` (String) The expiresAt value.
- `id` (String) The id value.
- `organization_id` (String) The  value.
- `prefix` (String) The prefix value.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) One-time API key token. Stored in Terraform state; unavailable after import. Creation requires a user OAuth bearer token, not an API key.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Replace identifiers with values from your organization.
terraform import ezghcloud_api_key.example 'ORGANIZATION_ID/KEY_ID'
```
